title: Chapter 159
text:
More than ten minutes later, Liu Cheng slowed down and fell to the ground. He had used up all his accumulated energy. He turned around and realized that Han Xiao was still following behind him like a ghost.

"Kill me."

The scars on Liu Cheng's face were too horrible to look at. He smiled sadly.

"I don't need you to tell me," Han Xiao said indifferently. He opened his palm and grabbed Liu Cheng's head. His fingers penetrated the skull.

When Liu Cheng stopped breathing, Han Xiao let out a sigh of relief.

"This is a strong opponent. I almost failed."

Looking at Liu Cheng's body one last time, Han Xiao fired a high-explosive bullet to prevent him from being eaten by the wild beasts. He then followed the sound of gunfire and returned to the battlefield in Green Valley Town.

The battle was even more intense. The gate of Green Valley Town had been blown up. The armored vehicles roared through the streets and fired at the machine gun positions built by the sandbags. The residents of Green Valley Town closed their doors and windows, covered their ears and shivered in the corners of their houses. Lu Cheng's troops consciously avoided the normal residents.

Since Liu Cheng had dragged him into the battle, he would end it quickly. Han Xiao set off to look for the commander of Green Valley Town. He looked for the commander in the town but found that there was no one to command.

On the other side of Green Valley Town, there were two distant tracks on the ground, indicating the direction of Balsas and Xiao Rui.

"Escaped?"

…

The off-road vehicle drove in the dark forest. The sound of gunfire in Green Valley Town gradually faded away. Xiao Rui, who was in the back seat, could see the fire behind him through the gaps in the trees.

"Liu Cheng is dead …" Xiao Rui clenched his fists and pressed them on his knees, barely suppressing his trembling legs.

Liu Cheng had served the family for more than ten years. He was loyal and was one of the strongest in the family. He had many amazing achievements. Xiao Rui had always regarded him as his backer. He did not expect that he would die in the hands of Black Phantom.

Xiao Rui originally thought that even if Liu Cheng could not stop Black Phantom, he could still escape unscathed. However, Liu Cheng's last words in the headset before he escaped made him feel like he had fallen into an ice cellar. He did not hear what Liu Cheng said at all. He only knew that his backer was about to fall.

Balsas and four armed guards were still in the vehicle. They looked nervous.

"Black Phantom is a monster. I told you not to mess with him! You didn't listen! "Balsas was sweating..

Xiao Rui's face was ashen. "Stop talking nonsense. At least we escaped!"

"He won't come after us, right?" Balsas kept glancing at the rearview mirror, his heart pounding.

Xiao Rui swallowed his saliva. "Lu Cheng is currently attacking Green Valley Town. The town guards are helping us hold off the enemy. He doesn't have time to chase after us."

Just as he finished speaking, a ghostly black figure appeared in the rearview mirror and followed them like a shadow. Everyone in the car screamed in fright!

"He's here!"

"Run!"

"Step on the accelerator all the way, don't let go!"

The people in the car were extremely panicked. The off-road vehicle was like a wild dog that was out of control. It sped up crazily and shook off Han Xiao for a moment. However, before they could breathe a sigh of relief, the car slowed down slightly. The black ghost was like a gangrene attached to the bone. It appeared behind them again like the King of Hell.

Everyone's adrenaline surged, and their hearts almost jumped out of their throats. They were so nervous that their bodies were stiff. The atmosphere of a horror movie finally made the driver make a mistake. In a panic, the car fell off the slope and rolled to the bottom of the slope with its four wheels facing the sky.

Xiao Rui was dizzy. He struggled to climb out of the car window. Suddenly, a pair of shining blue boots appeared in his sight. He looked up and saw Black Phantom looking down at him indifferently.

"Don't, don't kill me …"

Bang, bang, bang! Gunshots rang out continuously. Xiao Rui was so scared that he closed his eyes. After a while, he realized that there was no pain. He opened his eyes and found that the four armed guards were all shot dead. He and Balsas were left behind.

Xiao Rui was trembling. He had to stay calm in such a situation, but the fear of death made him unable to calm down. The fear was like a tide, drowning his heart time and time again. He didn't even dare to look straight into Han Xiao's eyes. He said in fear, "Black … Black Phantom, spare my life. I can give you a huge reward."

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. The reason he left Xiao Rui alive was because he found that he was sandwiched in the middle by the guards. He guessed that Xiao Rui was a big shot, so he purposely left him alive.

Balsas regretted having a conflict with Black Phantom and even more regretted listening to Xiao Rui's advice. He looked straight into Han Xiao's eyes and said angrily, "You liar, you've been working with Lu Cheng for a long time. You're not just passing by!"

He said that he wasn't interested in looking for trouble. It was all a lie!

Han Xiao stroked the pistol and chuckled. "Would you believe me if I said it was a coincidence?"

"I know I won't be able to live after falling into your hands. Kill me!" Balsas suddenly became tough and shook off Xiao Rui's hand that was anxiously pulling on his shirt.

"I don't know if you really want to die or if you're just pretending to be tough, but I'll do as you wish."

Bang! The bullet pierced through Balsas's temple. He fell down, and the pool of blood gradually expanded.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. It seemed that Balsas was not pretending. He was really desperate and wanted to die quickly. For a warlord like this who operated in the wild, even if they were afraid of death, they would accept it calmly when faced with death.

However, there was another person who was much more cowardly. Han Xiao looked over. Xiao Rui was so scared that he did not even dare to breathe loudly. His face was pale, and his back was covered in cold sweat.

Han Xiao squatted down and patted Xiao Rui's face with the gun barrel. "You don't want to die?"

Xiao Rui nodded quickly.

"Give me a reason."

"I … I can give you a lot of money. I can recommend you to the Overmera family!"

"Do I look like I need it?" Han Xiao pointed at himself with the muzzle of the gun.

Xiao Rui swallowed his saliva in fear and racked his brains to think of something that could move Black Phantom. Han Xiao's eyes were sharp. He suddenly saw that Xiao Rui's pocket was bulging. He reached out and took out a stack of bounty slips. It was actually a warrant for his Zero identity.

Why did the Overmera people have my bounty slips?

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows, waved the paper in his hand, and stared at Xiao Rui without saying a word. Xiao Rui saw that there was finally something that had attracted Black Phantom's interest. He quickly spilled the beans and told Black Phantom everything he knew.

"Xiao Han? Zero? The Overmera family? "

After hearing the information, Han Xiao was stunned.

He never knew that his original body had such a background!

"… You're not lying to me?" Han Xiao frowned.

Xiao Rui nodded repeatedly. Black Phantom seemed to be interested in Zero. He did not care about the reason. He only knew that he had a chance to live, so he did not have the heart to hide anything. He struggled to take out the car computer and opened the photos one by one.

The photos were of Han Xiao's original body in the Overmera family before he was taken away by the Germinal Organization. With this solid evidence, Han Xiao no longer had any doubts about his identity.

"So, I have a cheap father and a bunch of brothers and sisters?"

Han Xiaoxin's feelings were very complicated. He always thought that he had nothing to worry about in this world, but he did not expect that he still had this layer of fetters.

Overmera was his home. Han Xiao glanced at Xiao Rui. This person was also his family?

Overmera, a warlord in the Northern Continent. The second leader, Xiao Jin, is my original body's biological father. Their power is not small …

Han Xiao was silent as he pondered.

Xiao Rui's heart was in his throat. He was like a prisoner waiting for his sentence. He felt that this was the longest minute of his life.

"You can go," Han Xiao said lightly.

Xiao Rui could not believe it. He stood up trembling and ran two steps away. When he turned back and saw that Han Xiao was indifferent, he was ecstatic.

His life was saved!

He did not have any thoughts of revenge. He did not want to have anything to do with Black Phantom anymore. He ran as fast as he could.

Suddenly, there was a pain in the back of his head!

Xiao Rui lost control of his body. He ran two steps forward due to inertia and fell face first onto the ground. His pupils were dilated, and his face was blank.

What happened to me?

"So cold …" This was Xiao Rui's last thought in this world.

There was a deep bullet hole in the back of his head, and blood was flowing out.

Han Xiao put the Berserk Eagle back into the holster expressionlessly. He thought about it and decided to just kill him.

Overmera was the fetters of the original body. That unlucky guy's soul was already gone. He was him, not another person. Even if they were related by blood, Han Xiao would not treat Overmera as family, not to mention that the original body was killed by his big brother.

He would not inherit the relationship of the original body. To him, Overmera was like a stranger, not a concern.

He would kill if he had to!

Maybe with the original body's identity, he could get some help from Overmera, but with his status, he did not need to submit to such a level of power.

Most importantly, he did not want to do so.

"My family … is not in this world."

He set the body on fire, turned around, and left. The dancing flames made his silent shadow very long.
